```{r function-build_network_artist}
#' Build Artist Network
#' 
#' Useful for \code{\link{plot_tvc_network_artist}}.
#' 
#' @param song_credits a tibble as returned by \code{\link{parse_triade}}
#' @param triads a tibblespecifying the instrument that played the triad
#'
#' @return \code{build_network_artist} returns a list "data", "byArtists", "all_edges_that_matter", "edges".
#' 
#' @noRd
build_network_artist <- function(song_credits, triads){
  # data |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(ISRC == "CAC229000010")
  
  # song_credits |>
  #   dplyr::group_by(ISRC) |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(all(c("Jay Graydon", "David Foster") %in% name)) |> View()
  # data |>
  #   dplyr::group_by(ISRC) |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(all(c("Jay Graydon", "David Foster") %in% Artist)) |> View()
  
  # song_credits |>
  #   dplyr::filter(name == "John McCurry") |> View()
  
  # data |>
  #   dplyr::filter(Artist == "Peter Wood (2)") |> View()
  
  # song_credits |>
  #   dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USSM18600632") |> View()
  triadists <- filter_triadist(song_credits = song_credits, triads = triads)
  # triadists |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(Artist == "John McCurry")
  tvc_groups <- song_credits |> 
    dplyr::group_by(ISRC) |> 
    dplyr::summarise(
      Group = dplyr::case_when(
        all(is.na(triad)) ~ NA,
        any(triad %in% "1 7") ~ "TVC",
        TRUE ~ "no TVC")
    )
  data <- song_credits |> 
    dplyr::filter(name %in% triadists[["Artist"]]) |> 
    ## Final Formatting
    dplyr::select(c(ISRC, name, role, Album_Year, Album_Date)) |> 
    dplyr::distinct(ISRC, name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::rename(Artist = name) |> 
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(triadists, Artist, Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist),
                     by = dplyr::join_by(Artist)) |> 
    dplyr::left_join(tvc_groups,
                     by = dplyr::join_by(ISRC))
  
  data <- data |> 
    ## Collapse Artists who shared everything together (exemple: Orlando - Dalida)
    # dplyr::filter(Artist %in% c("Dalida", "Orlando") | grepl("Orlando", Artist)) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Artist, Date_First_Artist) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(hash_ISRC = digest::digest(head(sort(unique(ISRC[!is.na(Group) & Group == "TVC"])), 10))) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(hash_ISRC, Date_First_Artist) |> 
    # dplyr::filter(length(unique(Artist)) >= 2) |>
    # dplyr::distinct(hash_ISRC, Artist, Year_First_Artist) |> 
    # dplyr::arrange(hash_ISRC) |> View()
    dplyr::mutate(Artist = paste(unique(Artist), collapse = " - ")) |> 
    # dplyr::filter(grepl("Albhy Galuten", Artist), ISRC %in% c("USSM10209148"))
    dplyr::ungroup()
    
  # dplyr::anti_join(data2, data, by = dplyr::join_by(ISRC, Artist)) |> View()
  ## Old way
  # data <- song_credits |>
  #   filter_triadist(triads = triads) |> 
  #   ## Idee Baptiste : les Main Artist et Producteurs sont insignifiants, a approfondir
  #   # dplyr::filter(!role %in% c("Main Artist")) |>
  #   # dplyr::filter(!role %in% c("Producer", "Executive-Producer", "Co-producer")) |>
  #   ## Final Formatting
  #   dplyr::distinct(ISRC, Artist, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  #   # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "HKA610400625") |> View()
  #   # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "GB77R1400079") |> 
  #   # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USSM10209148") |>
  #   dplyr::select(-c(Nb_Songs_Artist, Nb_Album_Artist, Nb_Artist_Artist,
  #                    item.album.name, Instrument_Discogs, is_TVC_Instrument))
  
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, ISRC == "LivingTogetherFire&Rain", Artist == "David Foster")) == 1L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, ISRC == "GBBLG7700256", Artist == "Ray Parker Jr.")) == 1L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, ISRC == "ComeOnHomeCountryBoyTheKeaneBrothers", Artist == "Tom Keane")) == 1L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, ISRC == "QZF391800009", Artist == "Michael Landau")) == 1L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, ISRC == "GB77R1400079", Artist == "David Foster")) == 1L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, Artist == "Peter Wood (2)")) >= 2L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, ISRC == "USRC18702968", Artist == "Bill Cuomo")) == 1L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, Artist == "Gene Page")) >= 2L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, Artist == "Peter Wood (2)", ISRC %in% c("GB01A0600664", "USSM18600632"))) == 2L)
  ## John McCurry is not the main triadist in True Colors and the TVC in Poison is questionable
  # attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, Artist == "John McCurry", ISRC %in% c("USSM18900004", "USSM18600632"))) >= 2L)
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, grepl("Albhy Galuten", Artist), ISRC %in% c("USSM10209148"))) >= 1L)
  ## With Main Artist
  # attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data, Artist %in% c("Sheena Easton", "Michael Landau"), ISRC == "QZF391800009")) == 2L)
  # attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(data,  ISRC == "GB77R1400079", Artist == "George Harrison")) == 1L)
  
  #### Calcul des liens ####
  byArtists <- data %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Artist) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Nb_Songs = length(unique(ISRC[Group == "TVC"])),
                  Nb_Triads = length(unique(ISRC[Group == "TVC"]))) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Nb_Songs))
  edges <- data %>%
    # dplyr::filter(ISRC %in% c("USWB10202147", "USWB10202152", "USAM18300301"),
    #               Artist %in% c("Robbie Buchanan", "Michael Landau")) |>
    dplyr::select(Artist, ISRC, Group,
                  Album_Year, Album_Date,
                  Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist) %>%
    # dplyr::distinct()
    dplyr::full_join(x = ., y = .,
                     by = dplyr::join_by(ISRC, Group, Album_Year, Album_Date),
                     relationship = "many-to-many",
                     suffix = c("_from", "_to")) %>%
    ## Will we need both <--> edges in the end ?
    ## Adapt with Dates instead of Years
    dplyr::mutate(
      Need_Both = Album_Year > Year_First_Artist_from &
        Album_Year > Year_First_Artist_to &
        Year_First_Artist_from != Year_First_Artist_to,
      from_is_older = Year_First_Artist_from < Year_First_Artist_to,
      from_comes_first = purrr::map2_lgl(Artist_from, Artist_to, .f = ~ head(sort(c(.x, .y)), 1L) == .x)
    ) |> 
    dplyr::select(-c(dplyr::contains("Year_First_Artist_"), dplyr::contains("Date_First_Artist_"))) |> 
    ## Group
    dplyr::rename(from = Artist_from,
                  to = Artist_to) %>%
    dplyr::filter(from != to) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(Group, from, to)
  
  edges <- edges %>%
    dplyr::mutate(id = 1:dplyr::n())
  
  edges2 <- edges
  edges2$from <- edges$to
  edges2$to <- edges$from
  ## edges2$from_is_older is wrong on purpose
  ## edges2$from_comes_first is wrong on purpose
  
  tmp <- dplyr::bind_rows(edges, edges2) %>%
    # dplyr::group_by(Group, from, to) %>%
    # dplyr::arrange(Group, from, to, id) %>%
    # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "GBCCS1400011") |>
    # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "GBAKW0100140") |>
    dplyr::group_by(Group, ISRC, from, to) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Group, ISRC, from, to) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(Group, ISRC, from, to,
                   ## First Test (Meaningful for timeline graph)
                   dplyr::desc(from_is_older),
                   # Arbitrary
                   dplyr::desc(from_comes_first),
                   id) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  tmp$id %>% unique() %>% length()
  
  all_edges_that_matter <- edges |>
    # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "GBCCS1400011") |> 
    # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "GBAKW0100140") |>
    dplyr::filter(id %in% tmp$id | Need_Both) %>%
    dplyr::select(-id) |> 
    dplyr::distinct(from, to, ISRC, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
    dplyr::select(-from_is_older)
  
  # all_edges_that_matter |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(from %in% c("Humberto Gatica", "David Foster"), to %in% c("Humberto Gatica", "David Foster"))
  
  edges <- edges %>%
    # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "GBCCS1400011") |>
    dplyr::filter(id %in% tmp$id) %>%
    dplyr::select(-id) |> 
    dplyr::select(-from_is_older, -from_comes_first)
  # edges |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(from %in% c("David Foster", "JJ Lin") | to %in% c("David Foster", "JJ Lin"),
  #                 Album_Year %in% c(1975, 2003, 2013, 2020)) |> 
  #   dplyr::arrange(Album_Year)
  
  lout <- list(
    "data" = data,
    "byArtists" = byArtists,
    "all_edges_that_matter" = all_edges_that_matter,
    "edges" = edges
  )
  return(lout)
}
```
  
```{r example-build_network_artist}
build_network_artist()
```

```{r tests-build_network_artist}
})
```

```{r function-plot_tvc_network_artist}
#' Plot tvc songs network
#'
#' @param song_credits a tibble as returned by \code{\link{parse_triade}}
#' @param triads a tibblespecifying the instrument that played the triad
#' @param timeline a boolean specifying if the network should be plot on a timeline
#' @param year_range a numeric vector of length 2
#'
#' @return \code{plot_tvc_network} returns a network plot
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
plot_tvc_network_artist <- function(song_credits, triads, timeline = TRUE, year_range = NULL) {
  
  ltmp <- build_network_artist(song_credits = song_credits, triads = triads)
  data <- ltmp[["data"]]
  byArtists <- ltmp[["byArtists"]]
  all_edges_that_matter <- ltmp[["all_edges_that_matter"]]
  edges <- ltmp[["edges"]]
  
  #### vertices and edges ####
  
  bands <- list(
    # Les sommets = les artistes
    "vertices" = tibble::tibble(Artist = c(edges$from, edges$to)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Artist) %>%
      ## Label et Size
      dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(byArtists, Artist, Nb_Triads,
                                       Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist), # Nb_Songs
                       by = dplyr::join_by(Artist)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(size = Nb_Triads) %>% # Nb_Songs 
      dplyr::mutate(rownames = Artist) %>%
      dplyr::rename(label = Artist) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "rownames"),
    # Liens
    "edges" = edges |> 
      # tidyr::nest(vehicle = c(ISRC, Album_Year, Need_Both))
      dplyr::distinct(from, to, Group)
  )
  
  #### Main Grouping variables ####
  mainGroups <- c("TVC", "no TVC", NA)
  ## Degrees
  # mainGroups <- unique(grep(pattern = "^Degr", x = bands$edges$Group, value = TRUE))
  # suffixGroup <- "Degre-note-mediane"
  ## Harmonie
  # mainGroups <- unique(grep(pattern = "^Harmonie", x = bands$edges$Group, value = TRUE))
  # suffixGroup <- "Harmonie-Sous-Jacente"
  
  #### Network plot ####
  attempt::stop_if_any(bands[["edges"]]$from == bands[["edges"]]$to)
  attempt::stop_if_any(is.na(bands[["edges"]]$from))
  attempt::stop_if_any(is.na(bands[["edges"]]$to))
  attempt::stop_if_any(paste(bands[["edges"]]$from, bands[["edges"]]$to) %in% paste(bands[["edges"]]$to, bands[["edges"]]$from))
  # paste(bands[["edges"]]$from, bands[["edges"]]$to)[paste(bands[["edges"]]$from, bands[["edges"]]$to) %in% paste(bands[["edges"]]$to, bands[["edges"]]$from)]
  
  ## Year
  if(timeline) {
    if(TRUE) {
      ## Coordinate from grid layout
      # coords <- igraph::layout_on_grid(graph = fb.igra,
      #                                  width = 1
      #                                  ) |> 
      #   tibble::as_tibble(.name_repair = ~ c('x', 'y')) |> 
      #   dplyr::mutate(name = igraph::V(fb.igra)$name) |> 
      #   dplyr::select(-x) |> 
      #   ## Normalize y in [0; 1]
      #   dplyr::mutate(y = (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y)))
      
      ## Coordinates custom
      if (TRUE) {
        # as.numeric(igraph::neighbors(fb.igra, v = igraph::V(fb.igra)[["David Foster"]], mode = "all")) |> hist()
        d <- dplyr::bind_rows(
            ## Real Data
            {
              bands[["edges"]] |> 
                dplyr::mutate(weight = 1)
            },
            ## Years
            {
              bands[["vertices"]] |> 
                tibble::as_tibble() |> 
                dplyr::summarise(from = list(seq(min(Year_First_Artist) -10, max(Year_First_Artist) + 10))) |> 
                tidyr::unnest(from) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(x_from_init = (from - min(from))/(max(from) - min(from))) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(to = from + 1) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(from, to), as.character)) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(Group = "Years",
                              weight = 1e2)
            },
            ## Anchor Artist in Year
            {
              bands[["vertices"]] |> 
                tibble::as_tibble() |> 
                dplyr::rename(from = Year_First_Artist,
                              to = label) |> 
                dplyr::select(from, to) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(x_from_init = (from - min(from))/(max(from) - min(from))) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(from = as.character(from)) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(Group = "Anchor",
                              weight = 1.1) |> 
                dplyr::mutate(weight = dplyr::if_else(to == "David Foster", 1e10, weight))
            }
          )
        custom_graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
          d = d,
          directed = FALSE
        )
        init_coords <- tibble::tibble(
          from = igraph::V(custom_graph)$name
        ) |> 
          dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(dplyr::distinct(d, from, .keep_all = TRUE), from, x_from_init),
                           by = dplyr::join_by(from)) |> 
          dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(dplyr::distinct(d, to, .keep_all = TRUE), to, x_from_init),
                           by = dplyr::join_by(from == to)) |> 
          dplyr::mutate(x = dplyr::if_else(is.na(x_from_init.x), x_from_init.y, x_from_init.x),
                        x = dplyr::if_else(is.na(x), runif(dplyr::n()), x)) |>
          dplyr::select(-c(x_from_init.x, x_from_init.y)) |> 
          dplyr::mutate(y = dplyr::if_else(grepl("[0-9]{4}", from),
                                           runif(dplyr::n()), #0.5,
                                           runif(dplyr::n()))) |> 
          dplyr::mutate(y = dplyr::if_else(from %in% c("David Foster",
                                                       "1974", "1975", "1976",
                                                       "1960", "1961", "1962",
                                                       "2028", "2029", "2030"),
                                           0.5,
                                           y))
        custom_network_data <- ggnetwork::ggnetwork(
          custom_graph, #input: network object
          layout = igraph::with_fr(weight = igraph::E(custom_graph)$weight,
                                   coords = as.matrix(init_coords[, c("x", "y")]))
        ) |> 
          tibble::as_tibble()
        
        if(FALSE) {
          ggplot2::ggplot(
          custom_network_data,
          #can pass layout parameter
          ggplot2::aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend)
        ) + #mapping for edges
          ggnetwork::geom_edges(ggplot2::aes(#linetype = as.factor(Admin),
            color = Group),
            #arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed") #if directed
            # color = "grey50",
            # data = function(x) { x[ x$Group %in% mainGroups, ]},
            curvature = 0.1,
            alpha = 0.5
          ) +
          ggnetwork::geom_nodes(#ggplot2::aes(size = size),
                                # size = 3, color = conf
                                alpha=0.5) +
          ggnetwork::geom_nodes(fill = "#E74C3C", #"#D64545", "#C23B22", "red",
                                color = "black",
                                size = 5, shape = 21,
                                data = function(x) { x[ x$name == "Vanessa Carlton", ]}) +
          ggplot2::guides(alpha = "none") +
          ggnetwork::geom_nodetext(ggplot2::aes(label = gsub(" - ", ", ", insert_line_breaks_adaptive(gsub(" ?\\([0-9]+\\)", "", name)))),
                                   size = 2.5, nudge_y = .02) + # *.25
          ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2, 1)) +
          ggplot2::guides(linetype = "none",
                          colour = "none",
                          size = "none") +
          ggplot2::labs(y = "") +
          ggplot2::theme(
            panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), #remove minor gridlines
            legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill='transparent'), #transparent legend bg
            legend.box.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill='transparent') #transparent legend panel
          )
        }
        
        coords_raw <- igraph::layout_with_fr(graph = custom_graph,
                                         weight = igraph::E(custom_graph)$weight,
                                         coords = as.matrix(init_coords[, c("x", "y")])) |> 
          tibble::as_tibble(.name_repair = ~ c('x', 'y')) |> 
          dplyr::mutate(name = igraph::V(custom_graph)$name)
        anchors <- coords_raw |> 
          dplyr::filter(grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", name)) |> 
          dplyr::mutate(Year_First_Artist = as.numeric(name)) |> 
          dplyr::select(-name)
        coords <- coords_raw |>
          ## Remove Anchors
          dplyr::filter(!grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", name)) |> 
          ## Compensate Year y offset to 0.5
          dplyr::left_join(bands[["vertices"]], by = c("name" = "label")) |> 
          dplyr::left_join(anchors, by = dplyr::join_by(Year_First_Artist),
                           suffix = c("", "_year")) |> 
          dplyr::mutate(y = y + (0.5 - y_year)) |> 
          dplyr::select(-c(size, Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist, x_year, y_year)) |> 
          ## Transform Coordinates
          dplyr::select(-x) |> 
          ## Normalize y in [0; 1]
          dplyr::mutate(y = (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y)))
        
        
      }
      
      
      
      
      # coords <- igraph::layout_with_fr(graph = fb.igra) |> 
      #   tibble::as_tibble(.name_repair = ~ c('x', 'y')) |> 
      #   dplyr::mutate(name = igraph::V(fb.igra)$name) |> 
      #   ## Transform Coordinates
      #   ## Compute alternate y
      #   dplyr::mutate(y = sqrt(x^2 + y^2) * atan2(y, x)) |> 
      #   dplyr::select(-x) |> 
      #   ## Normalize y in [0; 1]
      #   dplyr::mutate(y = (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y)))
      
      network_data2 <- all_edges_that_matter |>
        # dplyr::filter(Album_Year %in% c(1964, 1966))
        # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USUG12000137") |> 
        # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "ComeOnHomeCountryBoyTheKeaneBrothers") |> 
        # dplyr::filter(name %in% c("Ron Fair", "Vanessa Carlton", "Samantha Mumba", "Christina Aguilera")) |>
        ## Remove collaboration ulterieures des memes personnes
        dplyr::mutate(from_to = purrr::map2_chr(from, to, ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "--"))) |> 
        dplyr::mutate(tmp_from_Need_Both = dplyr::if_else(Need_Both, from, "")) |> 
        dplyr::group_by(from_to, tmp_from_Need_Both) |> # from, to doesn't always works (cf. Need_Both)
        ## Remove noTVC link when a TVC link is available
        dplyr::arrange(Album_Year, dplyr::desc(Group == "TVC")) |>
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) |>
        dplyr::ungroup() |>
        dplyr::select(-from_to, - tmp_from_Need_Both) |> 
        ## Add coordinates Y
        ## full to add missing artists from "from"
        dplyr::full_join(coords, by = dplyr::join_by(from == name)) |> 
         # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USUG12000137") |> 
        dplyr::left_join(coords, by = dplyr::join_by(to == name), suffix = c("", "end")) |> 
        ## Label et Size
        dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(byArtists, Artist, Nb_Triads,
                                         Year_First_Artist, Date_First_Artist), # Nb_Songs
                         by = dplyr::join_by(from == Artist)) %>%
        dplyr::rename(size = Nb_Triads) |> 
        ## useless
        # dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(byArtists, Artist, Year_First_Artist), # Nb_Songs
        #                  by = dplyr::join_by(from == Artist), suffix = c("", "to")) %>%
        # dplyr::rename(size = Nb_Triads)
        ## New x
        # dplyr::mutate(
        #   x = Year_First_Artist,
        #   xend = Album_Year
        # ) |> 
        dplyr::mutate(
          x = Date_First_Artist,
          xend = Album_Date
        ) |> 
        ## Adjust Yend at the meeting place
        dplyr::group_by(ISRC, Need_Both) |> 
        dplyr::mutate(
          yend = if(all(Need_Both, na.rm = TRUE)) {
            (mean(yend) + max(yend)) / 2
          } else {
            yend
          }
        ) |>
        dplyr::ungroup() |> 
        dplyr::rename(name = from) |> 
        # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USWB18200003") |>
        # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USUG12000137") |> View()
        # dplyr::filter(ISRC == "USAT20003605") |> View()
        # dplyr::filter(name %in% c("Ron Fair", "Vanessa Carlton", "Samantha Mumba", "Christina Aguilera")) |>
        # dplyr::filter(name %in% c("Dave Mason", "Paul McCartney"), Album_Year %in% c(1965:1978)) |> # "George Harrison"
        # dplyr::filter(name %in% c("David Foster", "Boz Scaggs") | to %in% c("David Foster", "Boz Scaggs"),
        #               Album_Year %in% c(1977), xend == 1977) |>
        # dplyr::filter(name %in% c("David Foster", "JJ Lin"), Album_Year %in% c(1975, 2020, 2003)) |> # "George Harrison"
        dplyr::select(-to)
        
    }
  } else {
    fb.igra <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
      d = dplyr::select(bands[["edges"]], from, to),
      directed = FALSE
    )
    igraph::V(fb.igra)$conf <- bands$vertices[igraph::V(fb.igra)$name, "label"]
    igraph::V(fb.igra)$size <- bands$vertices[igraph::V(fb.igra)$name, "size"]
    igraph::V(fb.igra)$Year_First_Artist <- bands$vertices[igraph::V(fb.igra)$name, "Year_First_Artist"]
    igraph::E(fb.igra)$Group <- bands$edges$Group
    # igraph::E(fb.igra)$vehicle <- bands$edges$vehicle
    # igraph::E(fb.igra)$ISRC <- bands$edges$ISRC
    # igraph::E(fb.igra)$Album_Year <- bands$edges$Album_Year
    # igraph::E(fb.igra)$Need_Both <- bands$edges$Need_Both
    # E(fb.igra)$Admin <- bands$edges$Admin
    # E(fb.igra)$lty=ifelse(E(fb.igra)$Admin == 1, 1, 2)
    
    ## Provide the underlying dataframe
    network_data2 <- ggnetwork::ggnetwork(
      fb.igra, #input: network object
      layout = igraph::nicely()
    ) |> 
      tibble::as_tibble()
  }
  
  attempt::stop_if_not(nrow(dplyr::filter(network_data2, is.na(y) | is.na(x))) == 0)
  
  #Tips: ctrl+shift+A to reformat
  if(timeline && !is.null(year_range)) {
    filtered_network_data2 <- network_data2 |> 
      dplyr::filter(
        # dplyr::between(y, 0.3, 0.65), is.na(yend) | dplyr::between(yend, 0.3, 0.65),
        dplyr::between(Year_First_Artist, year_range[1], year_range[2]),
        is.na(Album_Year) | dplyr::between(Album_Year , year_range[1] - 3, year_range[2])
      )
    # dplyr::filter(network_data2, dplyr::between(x, 1975, 2004), is.na(xend) | xend < 2004),
  } else {
    filtered_network_data2 <- network_data2
  }
  
  set.seed(3212019)
  pggnetwork <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    filtered_network_data2,
    #can pass layout parameter
    ggplot2::aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend)
  ) + #mapping for edges
    ggnetwork::geom_edges(ggplot2::aes(#linetype = as.factor(Admin),
      color = Group),
      #arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed") #if directed
      # color = "grey50",
      data = function(x) { x[ x$Group %in% mainGroups, ]},
      curvature = 0.1,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    ggnetwork::geom_nodes(ggplot2::aes(size = size),
                          # size = 3, color = conf
                          alpha=0.5) +
    ggnetwork::geom_nodes(fill = "#E74C3C", #"#D64545", "#C23B22", "red",
                          color = "black",
                          size = 5, shape = 21,
                          data = function(x) { x[ x$name == "Vanessa Carlton", ]}) +
    ggplot2::guides(alpha = "none") +
    ggnetwork::geom_nodetext(
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = gsub("\n, ", "\n",
                     gsub(" - ?", ", ", 
                          insert_line_breaks_adaptive(gsub(" ?\\([0-9]+\\)", "", name))
                     )
        )
      ), # 1st occurence only
      size = 2.5, nudge_y = .02)+ # *.25
    # scale_color_brewer("Conference",
    #                    palette = "Paired") +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2, 1)) +
    ggplot2::guides(linetype = "none",
                    colour = "none",
                    size = "none") +
    ggplot2::labs(y = "") +
    # ggplot2::labs(colour = "Degr\u00e9 de la\nnote m\u00e9diane:") +
    # ggplot2::scale_colour_discrete() +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("#FCF1DD",  # Beige clair
                 "#EB5646",  # Rouge vif
                 "#A3472A",  # Terre cuite foncee, plus rustique
                 "#A3478A",  # Terre cuite foncee, plus rustique
                 
                 "#FCF3EE",
                 "black",
                 "#D9A066",  # Ocre dore, pour rechauffer et varier
                 "#7B2E2E")  # Bordeaux profond, pour l’ancrage visuel
    ) +
    # ggplot2::scale_colour_brewer(palette = 2) +
    # ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_d() +
    # ggnetwork::theme_blank() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      # panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill='transparent'), #transparent panel bg
      # plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA), #transparent plot bg
      # panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(), #remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), #remove minor gridlines
      legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill='transparent'), #transparent legend bg
      legend.box.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill='transparent') #transparent legend panel
    )
  pggnetwork
  return(pggnetwork)
}
```
